title: Accepted 'Something in the Reed-Cuts' (Fenmarch eel-trader's torn traps) but never found any way to close it in Fenmarch; a near-identical 'thing tearing up nets' bone-eel fight exists in a different hold (Saltkerns' Weeping Caves) and could easily be mistaken for the same problem, but the quest tracker never marked the Fenmarch one done.
